content.source: export const handler=async(input)=>{const keys=['external_supplier_openness','supplier_onboarding_accessibility','buying_procurement_accessibility','commercial_operational_feasibility','supplier_lock_in_barrier'];let known=0,points=0,total=0;const dimensions={},missing=[];for(const key of keys){const fact=input.supplier_access_dimensions?.[key]||{};const maximum=Number(fact.maximum)>0?Number(fact.maximum):20;total+=maximum;const ids=Array.isArray(fact.evidence_ids)?fact.evidence_ids.filter(Boolean):[];const observed=String(fact.state||'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase()!=='UNKNOWN'&&ids.length>0&&Number.isFinite(Number(fact.points));const value=observed?Math.max(0,Math.min(maximum,Number(fact.points))):null;if(observed){known+=maximum;points+=value;}else missing.push(key);dimensions[key]={state:observed?String(fact.state).toUpperCase():'UNKNOWN',points:value,maximum,evidence_ids:ids};}const coverage=total?Math.round(known/total*100):0;const accessScore=coverage>=50&&known?Math.round(points/known*100):null;const accessBand=accessScore===null?'UNKNOWN':accessScore>=80?'HIGH':accessScore>=60?'MEDIUM':accessScore>=40?'LOW_MEDIUM':'LOW';const model=String(input.buyer_model||'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase(),productBand=String(input.category_procurement_match_band||'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();let matrix='UNKNOWN_PRODUCT';if(model==='EXCLUDED_INTERMEDIARY')matrix='INELIGIBLE_BUYER_MODEL';else if(['LOW','VERY_LOW'].includes(productBand))matrix='LOW_PRODUCT';else if(['VERY_HIGH','HIGH'].includes(productBand)){const prefix=model==='DIRECT_END_BUYER'?'DIRECT_BUYER':model==='DISTRIBUTION_BUYER'?'DISTRIBUTION_BUYER':null;if(prefix)matrix=prefix+'_HIGH_PRODUCT_'+(accessBand==='HIGH'?'HIGH_ACCESS':['MEDIUM','LOW_MEDIUM'].includes(accessBand)?'MEDIUM_ACCESS':'LOW_ACCESS');}else if(productBand==='MEDIUM')matrix=accessBand==='HIGH'?'MEDIUM_PRODUCT_HIGH_ACCESS':'MEDIUM_PRODUCT_MEDIUM_ACCESS';const blockers=[];const relationship=String(input.relationship_status||'NEW_PROSPECT').toUpperCase();if(input.suppressed||relationship==='SUPPRESSED')blockers.push('SUPPRESSED');if(input.existing_customer||relationship==='INTERNAL_EXISTING_CUSTOMER')blockers.push('EXISTING_CUSTOMER');if(model==='EXCLUDED_INTERMEDIARY')blockers.push('INELIGIBLE_BUYER_MODEL');else if(!['DIRECT_END_BUYER','DISTRIBUTION_BUYER'].includes(model))blockers.push('REVIEW');if(['HISTORICAL_CRM_LEAD','HISTORICAL_CONTACTED_LEAD'].includes(relationship))blockers.push('HISTORICAL_REVIEW');const status=String(input.category_procurement_match_status||'NEEDS_PRODUCT_EVIDENCE').toUpperCase();if(status!=='CATEGORY_PROCUREMENT_MATCH')blockers.push(status);else if(input.category_procurement_match_score==null||Number(input.category_procurement_match_score)<60)blockers.push('WEAK_CATEGORY_MATCH');else if(Number(input.category_procurement_coverage||0)<70)blockers.push('NEEDS_PRODUCT_EVIDENCE');if(!input.has_verified_decision_route)blockers.push('NEEDS_DECISION_MAKER');if(!input.has_usable_contact_route)blockers.push('NEEDS_CONTACT_ROUTE');const verifiedActive=input.company_verified_active===true||(String(input.company_verification_status||'').toUpperCase()==='VERIFIED'&&String(input.company_lifecycle_status||'').toUpperCase()==='ACTIVE');if(!verifiedActive||!input.eligible_target_organization||!input.has_traceable_evidence)blockers.push('NEEDS_VERIFICATION');if(String(input.cooperation_feasibility_band||'').toUpperCase()==='LOW'||accessBand==='LOW')blockers.push('STRATEGIC_LONG_SHOT');if(Number(input.product_opportunity_count||0)===0&&status==='CATEGORY_PROCUREMENT_MATCH')blockers.push('NEEDS_PRODUCT_RECOMMENDATION');const order=['SUPPRESSED','EXISTING_CUSTOMER','INELIGIBLE_BUYER_MODEL','HISTORICAL_REVIEW','NEEDS_INTERNAL_CATALOG_EVIDENCE','NEEDS_PRODUCT_EVIDENCE','CATEGORY_MATCH_NEEDS_BUYING_EVIDENCE','PRODUCT_MISMATCH','WEAK_CATEGORY_MATCH','NEEDS_DECISION_MAKER','NEEDS_CONTACT_ROUTE','NEEDS_VERIFICATION','STRATEGIC_LONG_SHOT','REVIEW'];const readiness=order.find(x=>blockers.includes(x))||'SALES_READY';return{supplier_access_score:accessScore,supplier_access_band:accessBand,supplier_access_coverage:coverage,dimension_breakdown:dimensions,product_access_matrix:matrix,readiness,opportunity_readiness:readiness,readiness_blockers:[...new Set(blockers)],missing_evidence:missing,cooperation_calculation_version:'cooperation-feasibility-v3',rule_version:'cooperation-feasibility-v3'};};
